description: Two barrel saunas, both 1.97 m in diameter with 44 mm pine walls and a bitumen-shingle roof: the 1.7 m barrel for 2–4 people at €2,707, and the 5.9 m barrel for 4–8 people with a changing room at €7,655. Delivered to the UK, Ireland and Europe. Why a barrel. The round shape leaves little dead air, so it heats quickly and evenly, and the kit stands on two cradles with no deep foundation. 1.7 m barrel. One room, 700 × 1600 mm door, a 295 × 580 mm window, 2.08 m high. Offered in pine or thermowood. 5.9 m barrel. The same diameter with a 1.5 m changing room in front of the sauna room, a glued pine outside door and room for 4–8. On site. A level base, clear vents and the heater manual's clearances. Treat the outside of the barrel as you would any exterior timber; see the thermowood guide for the thermowood option. More room: cabin saunas. Prices: what a garden sauna costs.
